ref: debt panel-paper-fill-unbuilt (overlay panels carry no paper fill); src/app.jsx panelWrap
title: Should the web's Sorted by and History panels get the paper fill?
context:
Goal: an open panel reads cleanly against the list around it.
Problem (rule): on 2026-10-11 an orchestrator set the default that a panel takes the paper fill. You never confirmed or overruled it, and it was never built.
Based on (read): src/app.jsx panelWrap has padding and a top border, and no background.
Based on (read): the overlay of decision motion-disclosure-panels-arrive is not built. On main the panel pushes the rows down, so nothing shows through it today.
Departs from: main panelWrap has no background — option a adds the paper fill.

options.label: Confirm the paper fill
options.how: The Sorted by and History panels get the paper background. The designer also drew it with a 1 px ruled foot.
options.gain: The panel reads as one surface, and stays clean once the overlay is built.
options.lose: One more surface colour on screen.

links.label: Sorted by, paper with ruled foot, 375 px

options.label: Overrule it: panels stay with no fill
options.how: The default is dropped, and the debt closes.
options.lose: Once the overlay is built, the list shows through the panel.

why: It costs nothing today and keeps the panel clean once the overlay lands.
reply: You asked why there were no visuals. Each option now links its screenshots; the full mockup is in PR 252 (docs/design/panel-paper-fill.html).
